description.en: Opens a speech-bubble style dialogue message for a talking character (as opposed to CreateMessage's generic window or CreateMonologue's narration box) and waits for it to finish.
Optional speaker slot for the speech bubble (defaults to 0).
Optional; whether to show the bubble on the right side (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a speech-bubble message during a scripted sequence
CreateSpeech(_txt_id);
